ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons
